description: Draw the standings you read out of compare_creators or watchlist_standings. Free, and makes no requests — it only renders what you pass it: one row per creator with their window, their own median, how often they beat it and how hard, and their highest-performing post. Pass `ranking` to say which axis you ordered on, and `tooThin` for the creators whose window was too short to rank — a table that hides that is the one mistake this view can make on your behalf. Call this after you have decided what the numbers mean. Figures are checked against what nooticr returned in this session: its own numbers are drawn, and a row it never returned is drawn marked as unchecked, so there is no need to re-type them exactly.

creators.description: The creator rows, in the order you decided on — the same shape compare_creators returned (handle, platform, window, baseline, hitRate, medianWinRatio, best, ...).

metric.description: Which stat the standings are on (views, likes, ...).

ranking.description: What you ordered on and why — "how often they land one" and "how big it is when they do" usually disagree, so the reader needs to know which they are looking at.

tooThin.description: Handles whose window was too short to rank. Drawn as unranked rather than bottom, because missing from a comparison is not the same as losing it.

verdict.description: Your read, in a sentence or two.

name: show_standings

ranking.description: Which axis the order is on — 'how often' and 'how big' disagree.

tooThin.description: Handles drawn unranked rather than bottom.

status.description: verified: every row matched what nooticr returned this session. unverified: some are as re-sent.

unmatched.description: Rows not among what nooticr returned in this session; drawn as sent, unchecked.

title: Show Standings
